title: Handle an unknown URL
summary: Fiber: Handle an unknown URL. Visit / to compare.
introduction: A final Use handler can reply when no earlier route handled the request. Open GET /unknown.
learningObjectives: Handle an unknown URL with Fiber

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Handle an unknown URL
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Home") })
app.Use(func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.Status(404).SendString("Page not found") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: No earlier route handles /unknown, so the last middleware returns a 404 text response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Put a catch-all handler after the real routes.
